presets.label: Surrounding terrain
presets.description: Real surrounding roads, water and green space. A plum outline marks Leipzig; geography fades into muted ground at the wrap and poles.

presets.label: Continent Leipzig
presets.description: Leipzig becomes an island continent, with a pale coastal shelf and blue ocean.

presets.label: Fog of war
presets.description: Unexplored country disappears into rolling slate-coloured fog beyond Leipzig.
